title: Run a program with lowered priority
summary: Use the `nice` command to run a program with a lower scheduling priority. This allows other applications to use more CPU resources, preventing the background task from slowing down your system.

aliases.text: запустить в фоне с низким приоритетом

steps.explain: Run the command with a specific niceness value. Higher values mean lower priority (10 is a common choice for background tasks).

placeholders.name: NICENESS_VALUE
placeholders.description: The niceness value (0-19 for lowering priority). 10 is a common default.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command you want to run.

alternatives.explain: Explicitly specify the adjustment using the -n flag.
